site_number: TOWN CENTRE DEVELOPMENT, KEY SITE ONE
description: Demolition of existing houses, social club & some retail premises and the comprehensive redevelopment of Key Site 1 with the erection of a mixed use development comprising multiplex cinema, leisure and recreational facilities, town square, large retail unit, shops, restaurants, offices, hotel, health and fitness centre, creche,  medical and dentistry centre, private residential and key worker worker residential together with improvements to surrounding access routes and improvements to public transport including a new pedestrian link to Hounslow Central Underground Station and new access roads to the site, and the construction of car parks, access and service roads and landscaping.
site_name: TOWN CENTRE DEVELOPMENT, KEY SITE ONE
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - 2	A scheme of construction phasing of development within Phase 1 and Phase 2 shall be submitted to and agreed by the Local Planning Authority before development commences and the development shall be implemented in accordance with that phasing scheme unless otherwise agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority. Phase 1 shall comprise the hotel, large retail unit, health and fitness centre, medical/dentistry centre, cr?che, private residential, key worker housing, the school works, 400 car parking spaces, the link road (excluding the western Douglas Road link), and Phase 2 shall comprise the remainder of the development.

Condition : 3 - 3	No development shall take place within any construction phase previously agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development within that phase have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 4 - 4	The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the buildings are occupied.

Condition : 5 - 5	No additional floorspace shall be formed within the development hereby permitted by means of internal horizontal division without prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - 6	Unless otherwise agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority, no development within any construction phase previously agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority shall take place until full details of both hard and soft landscape works within that construction phase have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  These details shall include proposed finished levels or contours; means of enclosure; vehicle and pedestrian access and circulation areas; hard surfacing material; street furniture including seats, cycle racks, trolley bays, safety railings, refuse units, information boards, signage and lighting and CCTV cameras and equipment, and a public art feature.
Soft landscape works shall include planting plans; written specifications including cultivation and other operations associated with plant and grass establishment; schedules of plants, noting species, plant sizes and proposed numbers/densities where appropriate, and implementation programme.

Condition : 7 - 7	All hard and soft landscape works within each construction phase shall be carried out in accordance with the details approved under condition 6.  The works in each construction phase shall be carried out during the planting season following first occupation of any part of that construction phase, or as shall otherwise be agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 8 - 8	No development within any construction phase previously agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority shall take place until there has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority a plan for that construction phase indicating the positions, design, materials and type of boundary treatment to be erected.  The boundary treatment for any construction phase shall be completed before any buildings within that phase are occupied or in accordance with a timetable agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 9 - 9	A landscape management plan for each construction phase, including long term design objectives, management responsibilities and a schedule of landscape maintenance for a minimum period of five years after implementation of each construction phase, shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing prior to the occupation of any part of that construction phase of the development. The landscape management plans shall be carried out as approved.

Condition : 10 - 10	No works or development shall take place within any construction phase previously agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority until full details of all proposed tree planting, and the proposed times of planting within that construction phase, have been approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, and all tree planting shall be carried out in accordance with those details and at those times, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 11 - 11	If within a period of two years from the date of the planting of any tree, that tree, or any tree planted in replacement for it, is removed, uprooted or destroyed or dies, (or becomes, in the opinion of the Local Planning Authority, seriously damaged or defective,) another tree of the same species and size as that originally planted shall be planted at the same place, unless the Local Planning Authority gives its written consent to any variation.

Condition : 12 - 12	In this condition "retained tree" means an existing tree which is to be retained in accordance with the approved plans and particulars; and paragraphs (a) and (b) below shall have effect until the expiration of 5 years from the date of the occupation of [the health and fitness centre and cr?che].
(a)	No retained tree shall be cut down, uprooted or destroyed, nor shall any retained tree be topped or lopped other than in accordance with the approved plans and particulars, without the written approval of the local planning authority.  Any topping or lopping approved shall be carried out in accordance with British Standard 3998 (Tree Work) or as amended or replaced.
(b)	If any retained tree is removed, uprooted or destroyed, or dies, another tree shall be planted at the same place and that tree shall be of such size and species, and shall be planted at such time, as may be specified in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
(c)	The erection of fencing for the protection of any retained tree shall be undertaken in accordance with the approved plans and particulars before any equipment, machinery or materials are brought on to the site for the purposes of the development of each construction phase, and shall be maintained until all equipment, machinery and surplus materials have been removed from the site.  Nothing shall be stored or placed in any area fenced in accordance with this condition and the ground levels within those areas shall not be altered, nor shall any excavation be made, without the written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 13 - 13	The pedestrian and vehicular access arrangements shown on the deposited plan No A916/PL-005-E shall be implemented in all respects and made available prior to first occupation or use of any part of the development or in accordance with a phased provision previously agreed or subsequently agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 14 - 14	Before development commences a car park plan, including details of access, public and private parking facilities, cycle provisions, and spaces for people with disabilities, shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. The car park plan shall include 800 spaces made available for members of the public and no other purpose, and the development shall be carried out in accordance with the car park plan, or in accordance with phased provisions previously agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority.  Such spaces as approved for public parking shall be permanently available for public car parking use and not be used for any other purpose.

Condition : 15 - 15	Before development of each phase commences, details of proposals to maximise the available level of car parking on the site and provide a minimum of 400 car parking spaces for public use on site during the construction period shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and the development shall be carried out in accordance with such approved proposals.

Condition : 16 - 16	200 car parking spaces hereby approved shall be utilised solely for the residential element of the development and shall be provided within the site and made available prior to first occupation of the residential development, or in accordance with a phased provision previously agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority, and thereafter shall be permanently available within the development for the residents of those units and shall not be used for any other purpose. Prior to completion of the basement car park details of the permanent location of the 200 car parking spaces for the residential element of the development shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and shall be provided in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 17 - 17	The loading and unloading facilities within each construction phase shown on the plans hereby approved shall be constructed to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority and shall be available for first occupation of any part of that construction phase of the development, or in accordance with a phased provision previously agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority.  Such provision shall be permanently available for use and shall not be used for any other purpose.

Condition : 18 - 18	There shall be no direct through route for cars across the application site which would link Alexandra and Balfour Roads to the west with Prince Regent, Cecil and Kingsley Roads to the east of the site unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  Prior to the commencement of development (other than the hotel), details of the measures to prohibit or regulate access shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and the development shall be carried out in accordance with the details so approved.

Condition : 19 - 19	Before development of the residential elements of the development commences, details of cycle parking for residents shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority, and the spaces shown on the approved drawing shall be available for use before first occupation of any part of the residential development and permanently retained thereafter.

Condition : 20 - 20	Prior to the commencement on site of any construction work in any construction phase of the development hereby approved commencing on site, details of the arrangements for the construction traffic for that construction phase shall be agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority and shall include routes and access arrangements, hours of deliveries, wheel cleansing facilities and waiting areas.

Condition : 21 - 21	Unless otherwise agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority:
(a)	no part of the development shall be occupied until the works for the improvement of the access arrangements at the following junctions have been completed to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority:-
	High Street/London Road/School Road/Hanworth Road
(b)	no part of the development (other than the hotel) shall be occupied until the works for the improvement of the access arrangements at the following junctions have been completed to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority:-
	Kingsley Road/Cecil Road  (Site Access - East)
	Lampton Road/Balfour Road (Site Access - West)
	Kingsley Road/London Road
	Steve Biko Way/Staines Road	)
	Steve Biko Way/ Bath Road    )         Referred to as the 'Hospital Road Gyratory'		
	Hospital Road/Staines Road  	)
	Hospital Road/Bath Road 	)
(c)	no part of Phase 2 shall be occupied until the works for the improvement of the access arrangements at the following junctions have been completed to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority:-
	High Street/Douglas Road

Condition : 22 - 22	Unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority, no part of the development shall commence until proposals for the infrastructure to facilitate the routing of buses through the site, including bus stop locations and information systems, have been submitted to the Local Planning Authority, and such a scheme to be approved in writing and  that infrastructure relating to Phase 1 (other than the hotel) shall be constructed prior to occupation of any part of the Phase 1 (other than the hotel) and that infrastructure relating to Phase 2 shall be constructed prior to occupation of any part of Phase 2.

Condition : 23 - 23	Unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority, no part of the development shall commence (other than the hotel) until details of both cycle and pedestrian links throughout the site and how they link with the surrounding highway network have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and the development shall be carried out in accordance with such approved details.

Condition : 24 - 24	No part of the development shall commence (other than the hotel) until details of the design of the closure of Alexandra Road to vehicles has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority

Condition : 25 - 25	The access doorways to the shops, restaurants, cinema, and health and fitness club shall have a minimum clear width of 900mm, a level surface or ramp between the pavement and the floor and a door handle of not more than 1m above ground level.

Condition : 26 - 26	Before development within any construction phase previously agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority is commenced, a scheme for provision to be made for disabled people to gain access to all parts of the development within that construction phase shall have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The approved scheme shall be implemented before each construction phase of the development hereby permitted is brought into use.

Condition : 27 - 27	No development shall take place within the area indicated on drawing no. A916/PL-001D until the applicant has secured the implementation of a programme of archaeological work in accordance with a written scheme of investigation, which has been submitted by the applicant and approved by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 28 - 28	No part of the development within any construction phase previously agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority shall be occupied until details of the arrangements for storing of refuse or waste and recycling facilities within that construction phase have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  The arrangements for storage of refuse or waste and recycling facilities shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given and shall be completed before any part of the accommodation within that construction phase is occupied.

Condition : 29 - 29	Details of lux levels, direction and screening of any floodlighting within each construction phase shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority before development within that construction phase is occupied, and the development within each construction phase shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 30 - 30	No building hereby approved shall be occupied until a scheme for control of fumes and odours from that building has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing.  The scheme so approved shall be fully implemented before each building is open to customers.

Condition : 31 - 31	Construction of each underground car park shall not commence until a scheme for its ventilation including details of sound attenuation for any necessary plant and the standard of dilution expected has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, and no car park shall be used until such approved measures have been implemented

Condition : 32 - 32	No industrial, storage or retail activities shall take place anywhere on the site except within buildings or within other areas specifically approved for such purposes.  For the avoidance of doubt this condition does not restrict activities of a temporary nature such as displays, events and entertainment normally associated with a leisure and shopping environment.

Condition : 33 - 33	No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 0800 to 1800 on Mondays to Fridays and 0800 to 1300 on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and public holidays without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 34 - 34	The service area to the large retail unit on the north-eastern corner of the site hereby approved shall not receive any delivery vehicles between the hours of 11.00pm to 6.30am unless the service area is covered, details of which shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. If the service area is covered, servicing shall be between the hours of 7.00am and 11pm Monday to Friday. All other service areas and collection points shall only be operational between 7.00am and 11.00pm. Monday to Friday.  Any proposed variation to the above delivery times shall be first agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 35 - 35	Prior to the occupation of the large retail unit on the north-eastern corner of the site details of the link walkway between the rear of the site and Hounslow Central Underground station shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 36 - 36	Unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority, the amount of floorspace to be used for the purposes of Class A3 (Food and Drink) of the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 which is not an ancillary use not requiring planning permission shall not exceed 2800m2 (30,000sq.ft).

Condition : 37 - 37	The cinema, health and fitness club, day nursery, cr?che and health centre shall only be used for these purposes and for no other uses within Class D2 of the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 unless otherwise agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 38 - 38	An assessment of the effect of wind conditions with the development shall be carried out and agreed with the Local Planning Authority prior to the commencement of development and any mitigating measures in the agreed scheme shall be carried out prior to the occupation of any part of the development other than the hotel.

Condition : 39 - 39	Development of the non-residential uses hereby permitted shall not be commenced until full particulars and details of a scheme to insulate each of the premises against internally generated airborne and impact sound to the residential accommodation above and nearby has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and the development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given for that particular unit

Condition : 40 - 40	Construction of the residential flats hereby permitted shall not be begun until full particulars and details of a scheme to insulate the premises against internally generated airborne and impact sound, and against externally generated traffic, train and aircraft noise, for each phase of the residential development, has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and no development of any residential property shall be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given.

Condition : 41 - 41	Construction of the commercial units within each construction phase hereby permitted shall not be begun until full particulars and details of a scheme for the control of noise from mechanical plant, including details of sound attenuation, has been submitted to and approved in writing for that construction phase of the development by the Local Planning Authority. The development shall be carried out in accordance with any approval given.

Condition : 42 - 42	No part of the development within any construction phase previously agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority shall be occupied until a waste audit for that construction phase has been carried out to evaluate the types and quantities of waste the proposed development will produce.  Based on the findings of the waste audit, storage facilities will be designed to hold waste and recycled materials within that construction phase and sited to provide ready access.  As a minimum requirement, facilities will be identified for the recycling of glass, cans, paper and textiles.

Condition : 43 - 43	Prior to commencement of development a contaminated land assessment should be carried out to identify any previous industrial uses on, in, under or near the site, which could pose unacceptable risks to the proposed development,  future occupiers or adjoining land. This should be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing.  If the assessment identifies any unacceptable risks, further investigations and remedial measures will be agreed in writing and carried out to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority before development commences.
